header: READING THE PAX DIRECTORY (step 63a). I deliberately keep the table `public.pax_directory` (sql/12) OUT of the `nlq` schema, and it is closed to the public API roles (row level security on, everything revoked from `anon` and `authenticated`): only the application's OWN connection reads it. So this loader takes a plain query function and is given `getDb()`'s `query` (see omnibar.ts), NEVER the language model's read-only client (`deps.withClient`): the model must not be able to see this table, and with a dedicated NL2SQL_DATABASE_URL it could not read it anyway. The area (plant / outside plant / not classified) comes from the database function `public.pax_area(number)`, so the rule lives in ONE place. I normalise its words here, so a change of wording there ("plant" / "in plant") cannot turn a plant number into an unclassified one.
